registration_scope: Analysis plan fixed before this closing-stage computation; main experimental results had already been inspected. This is not a preregistration before conducting the experiments.
scope: Previously audited saved predictions and metadata only; no interaction data, models, checkpoints, tensor library, submitted collector or research code is accessed or executed.

accuracy.primary_view: canonical for Control/LBSP/Shuffle/TiSASRec; average of five final ensemble-group metrics within each training seed for Ensemble
accuracy.rank: strict-greater saved target rank, unchanged even when independently saved Top10 membership differs
accuracy.hr10_hr20_recall50: fraction with rank<=10, <=20, <=50 respectively; one positive per sample

populations.affected: at least two distinct raw history sequence hashes among fixed five permutations 101/202/303/404/505; canonical excluded; before LBSP canonicalization; same mask for methods and seeds
populations.pooled: last visible bucket size>=2; separate from affected
populations.bucket2: last visible bucket size=2, regardless of affected mask
populations.bucket3: last visible bucket size=3, regardless of affected mask
populations.bucket4: last visible bucket size=4, regardless of affected mask
populations.bucket5plus: last visible bucket size>=5, regardless of affected mask
populations.affected_bucket2: affected and last visible bucket size=2
populations.affected_bucket3: affected and last visible bucket size=3
populations.affected_bucket4: affected and last visible bucket size=4
populations.affected_bucket5plus: affected and last visible bucket size>=5
populations.empty_strata: retain n=0, missing numerical estimates; never impute zero

stability.panels: five fixed permutation outputs; for Ensemble five final score-mean group outputs
stability.overlap10: for each user average intersection size/10 over all 10 unordered pairs, then average users
stability.hitflip: fraction of users with both saved-rank hit@10 and non-hit among five outputs; not pairwise flip

aggregation_and_intervals.center: arithmetic mean of three training-seed values
aggregation_and_intervals.paired_control_comparison: within each dataset/population/training seed subtract Control from the method metric; aggregate the three paired differences with the same sample SD and t interval
aggregation_and_intervals.interpretation: Conditional on fixed data, protocol and the three specified training seeds. Intervals describe hypothetical independent approximately Gaussian training-seed variation; the fixed chosen seeds are not a random sample of all possible seeds. n=3 gives imprecise intervals. No multiplicity correction is made. No significance, superiority, equivalence or causal claims or confirmatory inference.
forbidden_pseudoreplication: three overlapping seed pairs as three independent runs
aggregation_and_intervals.bootstrap: not used; no resampling count or random seed is needed

training_seed_reference.view: canonical for trained non-ensemble methods; for Ensemble pair same group then average five group comparisons
training_seed_reference.reference_line: mean of the three seed-pair user-average Top10 overlaps, separately by dataset, method and population
training_seed_reference.pair_intervals: none; three pairs share models and are dependent

analytic_baselines: Saved Random and Popularity analytic expectations have no training-seed SD or training-seed confidence interval.
figure5: x=affected overlap10, y=affected paired Control delta ndcg10; both training-seed means and prespecified 95% t intervals. Timing marker sizes are measured inference costs with different repetition units.
